title: Power Rankings: Champs retake the throne
heading: 2008-09 Power Rankings: Week 13
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: It's not just the way they smoked Phoenix, smothered Orlando and disassembled Dallas in a span of seven days. The champs are back up here for how firmly they've hit back at this season's first dose of adversity.

rankings.summaryHtml: So do you think the Lakers -- fresh off toasting the Spurs and fully healthy for the first time in weeks -- are secretly freaked because they've played more home games and fewer roadies than anyone else? Us, neither.
